## Description

A self-intersection-detection pass on a wire whose pcurves describe a curve that revisits the same parameter range repeatedly (e.g., a small self-tangent loop) enters an infinite loop because the visited-segment map keys on segment ID, not segment + direction.

## Reproducer recipe

Wire whose pcurve traverses a small loop, returning to the same parameter region multiple times. Self-intersection-fix runs forever.

## Expected kernel behavior

every iteration in self-intersection-fix monotonically reduces a complexity measure (segments, intersections); if not, abort with diagnostic.
